name: Clash Royale Stats
hint: Needs the Clash Royale Stats module enabled.
desc: Use {clashroyale:variable} in a custom command to read this module's public values. Needs the Clash Royale Stats module enabled. Adding a variable does not enable its module. Disabled modules leave the variable visible in chat. Event-only values are empty when the command has no matching event; use a |fallback for empty values. The preview uses example data and does not confirm your module is enabled.
